verdict.rationale: Earth Class Mail publishes several per-item fees: check deposit at $20 per check, international forwarding at $5 per shipment plus postage, expedited forwarding at $10 per shipment plus postage, and expedited scanning at $15 per item. It also states storage terms (unlimited digital storage; physical letters held up to 30 days, packages up to 10 days). However, the core plan pricing is absent: no monthly price and no numeric scan allowance appear, only a 'plan limit'. Missing for 10: monthly plan prices, numeric scan allowances per plan, per-item overage fee for extra scans beyond the limit, domestic forwarding fee, fees for physical storage beyond the free period.

support.subject: As a founder, plan pricing is public and complete — monthly price, scan allowances, and the per-item fees for extra scans, forwarding, storage, and check deposit

citations.quote: $20 per check; complimentary overnight shipping is provided for checks deposited into accounts with Bank of America, JPMorgan Chase, and Wells Fargo.
International $5 per shipment plus postage ... Expedited shipment $10 per shipment plus postage
Unlimited cloud storage applies to digitized mail. Physical mail is stored for up to 30 days for letters and 10 days for packages
Scanning is free up to your plan limit, and secure shredding is included.
